owner_direction: Game theory and agent behavior, with options as the preferred application to investigate; prediction markets and justified crypto remain alternatives.
selection_rule: Choose an observable strategic mechanism first, then the venue and data that can test it.
horizon: One month to a reproducible research result and an honest paper-evaluation decision.
research_question: When do bounded agents respond correctly to incentives, information and risk constraints, and which measured behavior transfers to a market mechanism?

lanes.label: Options
lanes.mechanism: Inventory and hedging constraints interacting with demand and asymmetric information.
lanes.test: Test a preregistered change in spreads or relative option prices against observable demand or risk proxies, after conditioning on contract and underlying state.
requirements: Contract, expiry, strike and option type
Declared IV/Greek method and data entitlement
Observable treatment, costs and a chronological holdout
lanes.kill_condition: The proposed mechanism requires unobserved dealer inventories, disappears after spread and execution costs, or cannot be separated from ordinary risk exposure.

lanes.label: Prediction markets
lanes.mechanism: Belief aggregation, incentive-compatible reporting and strategic reactions to public information.
lanes.test: Compare preregistered calibrated forecasts with the contemporaneous market baseline on strictly future resolved events.
requirements: Exact resolution rules and settled outcomes
Brier or log score separate from executable returns
lanes.kill_condition: The gain requires information available only after the decision, settlement selection, or treating quoted probability improvement as realized trading profit.

lanes.label: Crypto where justified
lanes.mechanism: Venue-specific liquidity, funding or strategic participation, when the research identifies a testable mechanism.
lanes.test: Name the venue, asset, mechanism and observable intervention before registering a study.
requirements: Realistic fees, funding and execution assumptions
lanes.kill_condition: The asset was selected only because a collector already exists, or spot-data results are claimed to transfer to derivatives without validation.

next_agenda.label: Select the mechanism
next_agenda.deliverable: One falsifiable hypothesis with observed variables, alternatives and an explicit rejection test.

next_agenda.label: Prove the data can answer it
next_agenda.deliverable: A small entitlement-checked sample, as-of joins, missingness audit and cost model.

next_agenda.label: Freeze the experiment
next_agenda.deliverable: A registered baseline, chronological split, primary metric and stop conditions before outcomes are inspected.

next_agenda.label: Test transfer and decide
next_agenda.deliverable: A reproducible result, independent critique and a supported paper-study or no-go decision.

history_policy: Existing BTC collection and H1 receipts remain historical method evidence. They do not choose the next asset or establish an options result.

sources.title: Garleanu, Pedersen and Poteshman: Demand-Based Option Pricing
Cboe Option Quote Intervals: fields and coverage
